The '''Drate''' lizard were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of quadruped reptiles found on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="TOR" /> They had a frilled protuberance on top of the head and on both sides of the neck. They possessed a row of circular yellow spots on their flanks.<ref name="TOR" />
